name: BNM Feedback Statement: AI in the Malaysian Financial Sector
nature: Supervisory feedback statement. BNM is not introducing AI-specific regulation at this stage; existing policy documents (RMiT, Outsourcing, Corporate Governance and others) continue to apply.

controls.expectation: Assess risks before deployment; test and validate models; maintain human oversight.
Models that materially influence customer outcomes, such as credit underwriting, warrant more comprehensive testing and independent validation.
controls.note: ModelAssure validates decision behaviour against approved policies. Statistical validation (accuracy, calibration, stability) needs labelled outcomes and is a Phase 2 capability.

controls.expectation: Validate AI-enabled products and recommendations before deployment; institutions remain accountable for AI-driven decisions and outcomes.
Monitor for biased or unfair outcomes and maintain strong data governance.
controls.note: Not assessed by Version 1. Requires approved group-level metrics and appropriate data (Phase 2).

controls.expectation: Manage third-party and concentration risk, including limited visibility into vendor practices and embedded AI.
controls.note: Covers behavioural testing of vendor releases and dependency failures. Vendor due diligence, contracts and concentration risk are outside ModelAssure.

controls.expectation: Existing accountability requirements apply to AI-supported decisions; boards challenge material AI uses and management is accountable for outcomes.
Monitor AI systems on an ongoing basis to detect unintended outcomes.
controls.note: Version 1 tests releases before deployment; production monitoring is a later capability.
